name: Search Course Offerings
goal: Search published course offerings and inspect their details.

name: Register for Course Offering
goal: Register for a selected course offering during its registration period and receive the result.

name: Swap Course Registration
goal: Atomically swap a current registration for another course offering and receive the result.

name: View Current Registrations and Schedule
goal: View current registrations and the resulting class schedule.

name: Drop Course Registration
goal: Drop a selected registration during the allowed period and receive the result.

name: Export Class Schedule
goal: Export the currently viewed class schedule in a downloadable format.

name: Join Waitlist for Full Course
goal: Join the waitlist for a course offering when registration is rejected because the offering is full and waitlist is enabled.

name: Cancel Waitlist Entry
goal: Cancel a previously created waitlist entry.

name: Review Assigned Course Offerings and Rosters
goal: Review assigned course offerings and their current student rosters.

name: Manage Academic Term
goal: Create and update academic terms and their registration periods.

name: Manage Course Offering
goal: Create, update, publish, or cancel course offerings and assign instructor, meeting schedule, and enrollment capacity.
